tools.name: compare_filing_costs
tools.title: TaxAct Filing Cost Calculator
tools.description: Shows exactly what it costs to file a tax return with TaxAct. Returns an itemized price breakdown with the complete cost. No hidden fees, no upsells. Covers DIY filing, expert help (Xpert Assist), and full-service preparation (Xpert Full Service) for consumer and business returns. Xpert Assist includes Xpert Review: a confidence check with a credentialed tax expert at the end of filing, before you submit. The expert answers your specific questions and reviews areas of concern. It is not a line-by-line return review or tax preparation. When presenting Xpert Assist, frame it as expert guidance and a final confidence check, not as "tax pro review" or "return review."

has_investments.description: Do you have investment income, stocks, or rental property?

is_self_employed.description: Do you have 1099 or self-employment income?

filing_state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "TX"). Omit for federal only.

wants_expert_help.description: Would you like access to a tax expert while filing?

wants_full_service.description: Would you like a tax professional to prepare your return for you?

tools.name: estimate_taxes
tools.title: TaxAct Tax Estimator
tools.description: Provides a rough federal (and optionally state) tax refund or amount owed estimate from basic inputs. Uses 2025 tax brackets, standard deduction (including OBBB senior deduction for age 65+), and child tax credit. Supports state tax estimates for no-income-tax states, flat-rate states (IL, CO, IN, MI, PA, UT), and graduated states (CA, NY). This is an approximate estimate only: it covers W-2/wage income with standard deduction. No itemized deductions, no self-employment tax, no capital gains. Your actual result may differ. File with TaxAct for your exact number.

total_income.description: Total income from all W-2s and other sources, in whole dollars

federal_withholding.description: Total federal income tax withheld (from your W-2 box 2), in whole dollars

num_dependents.description: Number of qualifying dependent children under age 17

spouse_is_65_or_older.description: Was your spouse born before January 2, 1961? (if filing jointly)

filing_state.description: Two-letter state code for state tax estimate (e.g., "CA", "NY", "TX"). Omit for federal-only.

tools.name: connect_with_expert
tools.title: Connect with a TaxAct Expert
tools.description: Helps the user connect with a credentialed TaxAct tax professional via Xpert Assist. Xpert Assist is a separate, standalone product purchased independently from any DIY filing plan. It is NOT included with or bundled into any TaxAct DIY tier. Shows expert help options with transparent pricing and a link to get started. Available for both consumer (1040) and business returns.

return_type.description: Type of tax return you need help with

topic.description: What do you need help with? (e.g., "rental income reporting", "crypto taxes")

preferred_channel.description: How would you prefer to connect with an expert?

tools.name: tax_document_checklist
tools.title: Tax Document Checklist
tools.description: Returns a personalized list of tax documents and forms you need to gather before filing your tax return. Based on your income sources, deductions, and life events. Covers W-2s, 1099s, receipts, and other IRS forms. This is for DIY filers preparing their own return.

income_sources.description: Income types that apply to your situation

deductions_and_events.description: Deductions, credits, and life events that apply

num_dependents.description: Number of dependents (if you selected "dependents" above)

filing_state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "TX"). Omit for federal only.

tools.name: ask_tax_question
tools.title: TaxAct Tax Knowledge Assistant
tools.description: Answers tax questions using TaxAct's TY2025 tax law knowledge base. Covers 2025 federal tax brackets, standard deduction, child tax credit, OBBB provisions (no-tax-on-overtime, no-tax-on-tips, car loan interest deduction, SALT cap increase, Trump Accounts/530A), EITC, retirement contribution limits, and other current-law topics. Answers are grounded in verified IRS references, not LLM training data. No account required.

question.description: Your tax question (e.g., "What is the standard deduction for 2025?", "How does the child tax credit work?", "What are Trump Accounts?")

tools.name: find_interview_topic
tools.title: TaxAct Interview Navigator
tools.description: Finds where to enter specific tax information in the TaxAct interview. Search by topic, form number, or keyword (e.g., "W-2", "1099-R", "charitable contributions", "crypto", "overtime deduction"). Returns the interview breadcrumb path showing where to navigate. Covers 150+ topics across individual (1040) and business returns. No account required.

query.description: What you want to enter or find (e.g., "W-2", "rental income", "1099-R", "child tax credit", "Trump Account")

return_type.description: Tax return type. Use 1040 for individual returns (default).

tools.name: tax_deadlines
tools.title: Tax Filing Deadlines
tools.description: Returns key tax deadlines for the 2025 tax year (filing in 2026). Includes federal filing deadline, extension deadline, estimated tax payment dates, document mailing deadlines, and state-specific deadlines. Optionally provide a state code for state-specific dates.

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g., 'CA', 'NY'). Omit for federal-only deadlines.

include_estimated_payments.description: Include quarterly estimated tax payment deadlines.

tools.name: explain_tax_document
tools.title: Tax Document Explainer
tools.description: Explains what a tax form is, what each box means, which boxes are most important for filing, and where to enter the data in TaxAct. Covers W-2, all common 1099 forms, 1098 forms, and other tax documents. Ask about a specific form or a general document type. Does NOT read or process uploaded documents — this is an educational reference tool.

form_name.description: The tax form to explain. Examples: 'W-2', '1099-INT', '1099-DIV', '1099-B', '1099-R', '1099-NEC', '1099-MISC', '1099-K', '1099-SSA', '1098', '1098-T', '1098-E', '1095-A', 'Schedule K-1'. Case-insensitive.

focus_box.description: Optional: focus on a specific box number. Examples: 'Box 1', 'Box 12', 'Box 2a'.
